content:
Best Buy has updated its massive 60th anniversary sale with new deals, plus AirPods Pro 3 are 25% off, AirPods Max 2 are down $120, and AirTag 2 hit their all-time lows. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break also has 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro down a massive $500 via Amazon, Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card drops to a new all-time low of $25, and Mint Mobile debuts an unprecedented 50% off on its Unlimited 1-year talk/data plan for just $15/month. All the deals are below.

Best Buy updates massive 60th anniversary sale with new deals: TVs from $110, up to 50% off electronics, up to $1,000 off appliances, more

AirPods discounts stack even deeper with up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 are 25% off, more

After a summer of steady deals on the latest AirPods lineup, nearly every model is getting another price cut. The highly sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now down 25% as one of their all-time lows, and we’re also seeing AirPods 4 ANC fall to their lowest price in months, while AirPods Max 2 drop another $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (orig. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (orig. $129)

Rare deal: M4 Mac mini drops $100 at official Apple Refurb store in limited-time return

Update: This deal has sold out, we’ll keep an eye out for restocks.

There are plenty of great deals on the AirPods Pro 3 and the new AirTag 2 and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, but the new M4 Mac mini has been extremely difficult to buy. It can hardly be found anywhere from retailers like Amazon and Best Buy anymore — places that often had it on sale. We’ve now spotted an extremely rare opportunity to pick up the 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini for $150 off via the official Apple Refurb store.

The official Apple Certified Refurb store is now selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849 with free shipping.

Down even more: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro drops a massive $500 via Amazon

This week during a special one-day Apple event, the all-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations saw some solid $400 price drops. But we wanted to spotlight one specific model — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now down $500 at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB internal SSD for $2,699 with free shipping.

This $3,199 configuration has the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (the one that’s $400 off is the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU). Although this one just got a price increase, it’s now $100 cheaper than the older lower MSRP.

Both are great options depending on how much power you need — now $400 and $500 off list price, and the CPU/GPU upgrade was an extra $200 originally, but only $100 more at our deals here:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (orig. $2,999) 15-core CPU & 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (orig. $3,199) 18-core CPU & 20-core GPU

We expect this $500 discount to jump back up soon, but whether it lasts through Sunday and the end of this week’s big sale day remains to be seen.

Apple’s latest AirTag 2 hit all-time lows at Amazon this week, but now you can get one for $20

Apple deals are lining up this week, with AirPods Pro 3 still 25% off and AirPods Max 2 down $120 as one of their all-time lows, alongside $500 off select M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations, some of the more notable deals have also landed on the latest AirTag 2 trackers — single and 4-packs are back to their all-time lows, and you can now grab one for $20.

Amazon now has both the single and 4-pack AirTag 2 listings priced back at the lowest we’ve tracked since their release earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (orig. $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (orig. $99)

The 4-pack brings the per-Tag price down to $22.25, while the single AirTag 2 is back at its Prime Day all-time low of $24.

While it’s not a huge gap, it’s worth noting that Best Buy’s “excellent” open-box listing for a single AirTag 2 is also at the lowest price we’ve tracked — you can grab one for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 “excellent” open-box $20 (orig. $29 new) | Best Buy

Although it’s only $4 cheaper than Amazon’s new, I’d personally take that route, but it is indeed cheaper. Best Buy is also offering the same discount on the new listing, so if you’re already ordering from its ongoing 60th anniversary sale, it’s worth checking that option out as well.

Apple Watch Series 11 drops $100 for Anniversary Week, Best Buy open-box units from $254

Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card (works on iOS or Android) drops to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently launched its brand-new SmartTrack Find My Card for your wallet — the first product to support both Apple’s tracking platform and Google Find Hub — and it’s already dropped to a new Amazon all-time low of $25 with Prime shipping.

Anker’s official EufyHome Amazon store is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 (works on iOS or Android) for $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

It landed on Amazon last month for $35, then got a small $5 discount at the end of the month, and is now seeing its first significant price drop for a new Amazon low.

That’s essentially 30% off, and the price is in line with some of the best deals we’ve tracked on similar wallet tracker cards this year.

I’m personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards — they start at $35 with the Pro model going up to $45, and have up to 16 months of battery life before needing a recharge — but no matter which one you choose, I think everyone should have one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave the house without one.

Anker’s latest SmartTrack Card E40 packs all of the most important features, including wireless charging, while being compatible with either Apple’s Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It’s only 1.7mm thick and can emit an 80dB sound to help you track it nearby — and of course, it can be loaded directly into the Find My and Find Hub apps to see its location on the map.

Mint Mobile now offers an unprecedented 50% off Unlimited 1-year talk/data plan for just $15/month

Mint Mobile is now running a few unprecedented deals on its unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plans. While this carrier offers decent value most of the time, it’s now offering its Unlimited 12-Month Plan for just $15/month, which is half off, making a full year of unlimited talk, text, and data just $180. Even if you’re not looking to switch your main plan right now, this price is low enough to be worth considering as a backup or iPad line.

While you’ll also find discounts on its 17GB and 23GB plans, the best value here is the 5G • 4G LTE Plan: 12 months of unlimited MO for just $15/month.

  • Unlimited 12-Month Mint Mobile Plan $15/month (50% off)

According to the details, you’ll need to prepay the $180 12-month plan cost (which equates to $15/month), but for those looking to switch to a new carrier at a discount or start a line for another device/backup, this is a pretty serious deal.

If your phone supports eSIM, you can “activate service instantly” — it also works with a range of Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. You can also keep your existing number and bring your own unlocked phone if needed.

Head over to the deals page for more details.

New wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low at Amazon, nearly 70% off (wired model also on sale)

Amazon’s end-of-summer round of discounts on Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear also brought the new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro down to its latest all-time low, while also bringing back the Prime Day all-time low on the wired model, both roughly 30% off list price.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (orig. $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (orig. $250)

Today’s accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker’s MagSafe power banks are on sale starting at $36 this week (lots of color options)
  • Anker’s 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is one of the best out there, now 35% off (matches all-time low)
  • Twelve South’s Curve Nano is one of the best-looking MagSafe stands I’ve seen, grab it for $27 (orig. $35)
  • Twelve South’s all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable now $36
  • Woot’s massive PC sale kicks off with up to 75% off gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, more from $5
  • This mini SSD enclosure with display and power-loss protection is now $29
  • Razer’s portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub drops to all-time low of $52 (57% off)
  • Twelve South’s USB-C wall charger with Find My hits new Amazon all-time low at under $37
  • Whoa! These leather Apple Watch bands are just $6 with Prime shipping (75% off)

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 down $120 (one of the all-time lows)

This week’s massive 60th anniversary sale brought one of the all-time lows for Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering all five colors down $120 off list.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

It’s $120 off the $549 list price, which is the lowest price we can find right now from a reputable retailer for brand-new condition.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black version available for an even cheaper $403.99 shipped in “excellent” open-box condition, but it’s not quite low enough to pass up the new one.

Apple actually put some effort into a brand-new generation of AirPods Max this year instead of just refreshing the shell and adding a USB-C port like the previous generation. The thing is, it’s not expected to update its over-ear options at next month’s new product event like the in-ear AirPods lineup, so the $120 off we have this week might be the best deal on Apple’s newest and best over-ear headphones for some time.

The only other sale that had it priced lower was this summer’s Prime Day, when it was selling for $30 less than today’s deal price — and the stock was very limited and inconsistent during the 4-day promotion.

Amazon’s best Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models are now $220 off (matches Prime Day pricing)

While the official Apple Certified Refurb store is our top recommendation for scoring a deal on iPhones, Apple doesn’t yet sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there, and it doesn’t look like it will before next month’s 18 series release. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings are now back at Prime Day pricing, up to $220 off new list price.

Amazon’s top-tier Premium Renewed models have been the best option for scoring an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro so far. Not only do you save hundreds, but you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% of original battery life” — some of the non-“Premium” Renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty, and won’t have the same battery life rating.

You can now see both 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models back in stock at up to $220 off — the 512GB version is $20 cheaper than the last time we mentioned it:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (orig. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (orig. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (orig. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (orig. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (orig. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (orig. $1,299 new)

As we mentioned in yesterday’s Apple Refurb store spotlight, you can grab an iPhone 16 with 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699, as well as the 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,279 — which is $330 less than the equivalent 17 Pro Max and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 lineup)

Anker 45W Nano Smart Display charger still at its $26 low, but the bundle now adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more
